name: Helga Ironettle
source_profile:
Hearthwarden Helga Ironettle (LG) — Elder of Emberhearth

Helga is a respected master smith whose grandfather escaped the fall of Thuldren Deep. She is a formidable, plainspoken woman who believes the dwarves must build a future for themselves rather than spend their lives mourning kingdoms that have been lost for generations. Under her leadership, Emberhearth has become a prosperous community that welcomes displaced dwarven families and offers apprenticeships to young craftspeople, including those of other ancestries.

Although generally supportive of Cadorian commerce, Helga fiercely opposes attempts by wealthy merchants to monopolize the work of independent smiths.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 77 (source excerpt; may be partial)
